procedural_exemplar_value: Provides structurally different fast/safe-lane corridor taxonomy, dual physical grade interchanges, a grounded multi-span machine-network grammar and a deterministic 31x27 passing-choice fixture.

The design makes horizontal counterflow and two discrete lane weave decisions its dominant legible morphology; minimal spare areas remain intentionally editable.
